skill_name: Describe in detail the characteristics of an LED light.
workflow: LED lights are characterized by their small size, low power consumption, durability, and long life span. They are highly efficient, using up to 90% less energy than incandescent bulbs and approximately 20-30% less energy than compact fluorescent lamps. LEDs also produce very little heat and are adjustable in terms of both intensity and color.
